Reveal: a wide night avenue — traffic lights blinking amber, cars left with doors open, a city bus lying on its side across two lanes, thin ground fog, wet reflections. **CHARACTER ACTION:** Arin lies flat, one hand pressing his own mouth shut, the other creeping out for the phone. He stays motionless while the shambler passes, eyes tracking her foot. He vaults a bonnet; the Driver goes over it on all fours like an animal. A narrow side street: shuttered shops, a toppled shopping trolley, a cable from a fallen pole across the ground. **VISUAL DESCRIPTION:** 01:00. The outside bolt slides home — a dull, wrong-sounding clack (it closed on tape). Sara and Arin, on opposite bunks, look at each other in the dark. Lamp out.
